title: Cloud Parade A-Z
hook: Clouds cover some of the sky, never all of the story.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: soft 3D sky-and-cloud storybook, blue-white palette with weather icons rendered as objects, crisp simple silhouettes

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child slowly framing sky scenes from an observation spot
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written sky framing; gear and instruments are ground-station context
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: frame cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe point/shape gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. glockenspiel or marimba weather-signals after the word, with percussion ducking on onset
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: glockenspiel or marimba weather-signals after the word, with percussion ducking on onset
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn Cloud Parade into a slow sky gallery: cloud layer, coverage, optical effects, weather tools and clothing enter the frame one by one without pretending every mapping target is a cloud.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: The child frames one part of the sky at a time—low, covered, clearing, rainbow, storm center, sun—while instruments sit at the observation station below.
semanticArc: finish at ground instruments under changing sky
